title: TurboHire integration (ATS & HRMS) | Xobin
text:
About TurboHire
TurboHire is an AI-driven recruitment automation platform that helps teams screen, rank and engage candidates at scale. It combines resume intelligence, structured workflows and hiring analytics in one system.
Why Integrate TurboHire with Xobin?
Integrating TurboHire with Xobin connects skill assessments to your candidate evaluation workflow. Recruiters can send Xobin assessments, track candidate performance and automate test assignment within TurboHire. It ensures a data-driven hiring process, reduces manual effort and improves hiring efficiency.
How to Integrate TurboHire with Xobin
Obtain your TurboHire API key
Log in to your Xobin dashboard.
Open the
Settings
menu and select the
Integrations
tab at the top right.
Scroll through the list and select
TurboHire
Click
Contact Support
. A chat window opens in the bottom-right corner and our team will provide your API key.
If an API key is already shown in the TurboHire section, simply copy it and continue.
Enable the Xobin integration in TurboHire
Log in to your TurboHire dashboard.
Navigate to
Settings > Advanced Settings > Integrations
Search for
Xobin
and click
Enable Xobin
Paste the API key obtained from Xobin into the field.
Update
to finalise the integration.
Track API usage
In your Xobin dashboard open the
API Logs
menu.
Here you will find detailed insight into your API call consumption and usage history.
Your Xobin and TurboHire integration is now complete.
Who is this integration for?
This integration is designed for recruitment teams, HR professionals and hiring managers who want to automate skill assessments, track candidate performance efficiently and run assessments inside TurboHire. It is especially beneficial for organisations that need a streamlined, data-driven hiring workflow.
Capabilities
Features & benefits
Guided key provisioning
Request the TurboHire API key from Xobin support in one click, or copy it directly if it is already issued to your account.
One-field activation
Enable Xobin under TurboHire Settings > Advanced Settings > Integrations and paste the key to go live.
Assessments in the screening flow
Send Xobin tests and track candidate performance alongside TurboHire's AI screening and ranking.
API usage visibility
The API Logs menu in Xobin shows call consumption and usage history for the integration.
AI screening plus verified skill
TurboHire ranks and shortlists applicants while Xobin proves capability with a scored assessment.
Support-assisted activation
Xobin support issues and troubleshoots the integration key, so going live takes minutes.
Answers
Frequently asked questions
Open Xobin Settings > Integrations > TurboHire and click Contact Support. Our team issues the key in chat. If a key is already displayed, copy that one.
